Set up Reaper

Two ways in, and the difference matters: a new name is a brand new account, while linking joins an account you already have on another device.

No password and nothing to sign up for. Your account is a key already on this machine — the name is just what people see.

On the device you already use, open Settings → Devices and choose Link a device. It will show a code and a passphrase — you need both, and they last ten minutes.
